question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Feasibility
solution: The correct answer is: **Probability**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Feasibility **means the likelihood or possibility of something happening. (कुछ घटित होने की संभावना) • **Example**: *The feasibility study concluded that implementing the new technology is economically viable for the company.* • **Probability **is a synonym of feasibility because it also refers to the likelihood or chance of something occurring. (किसी चीज़ के घटित होने की संभावना) • **Example**: *There is a high probability of rain tomorrow, so you might want to carry an umbrella.* Thus, **option 4** is the correct answer. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Sustainability **refers to the ability to maintain or continue something over time, often in reference to environmental practices. (किसी चीज़ को समय के साथ बनाए रखने या जारी रखने की क्षमता, अक्सर पर्यावरणीय प्रथाओं के संदर्भ में) • **Impropriety **means improper behaviour or conduct. (अनुचित व्यवहार या आचरण) • **Heavy **refers to something that is of great weight or burden. (कोई ऐसी चीज़ जो बहुत अधिक वजन या बोझ वाली हो) 3f:T602, The correct answer is: "**Would you rather eat pizza or burger?**"
